assessment: The article demonstrates that endogenous oxidized phospholipids (OxPLs) can stimulate inflammatory responses in host cells, including induction of cell death and processing of interleukin-1 β. The article further identifies a host enzyme, acyloxyacyl hydrolase (AOAH), that cleaves oxidized phospholipids and thereby reduces their pro-inflammatory properties. These are important findings that shed light on the mechanisms that limit damaging inflammation, and the findings should be of broad interest.
